about: Modulos opcionais do motor. Uma fonte so' para o CMake (opcao, fontes, implementacao muda), o perfil de build do jogo exportado e a janela de exportacao do editor (deteccao no projeto). Desligado, o modulo troca as fontes pela implementacao muda com a mesma interface.

modules.name: vfx
modules.label: Particle effects
modules.summary: GPU particle effects: vfx.*, map effects, ambient particles

modules.name: draco
modules.label: Draco meshes
modules.summary: decoder for glTF meshes compressed with KHR_draco_mesh_compression (~0.5 MB)

modules.name: neural_pbr
modules.label: Neural PBR
modules.summary: PBR maps from a neural network at load time (the model is not exported)
